reference.observation: Raw Calendar local picker/shared prefixes, independent Select/Radio child namespaces and canonical variables. 21 cases in normal/nested/reset scopes, full/mini/date/month/week/RTL, valid range, aliases/styles and responsive viewport 480/481. Fixed now 2024-09-15; selected date retains source timestamp. Live year input selection/caret/focus; the source header does not enable search. All raw cases/live transitions precede a public style.width=400 counterpart for the constrained 320px alias header. Only header control heights use this counterpart: Native preserves its existing nowrap boundary while Source wraps mode labels and stretches controls. Other metrics retain raw 320px values. No Source patches or private APIs.
